text:
michael: Heads up - running into weird mismatch between synthetic load and replay harness for toolcall-heavy traces. Synthetic shows 18% JSON-mode CPU overhead; replay is only ~6%. Not sure which is closer to production.
anya: interesting. are the sequences identical? token lengths?
michael: same prompt set, but replay includes real user timing gaps. synthetic hammer runs back-to-back.
jordan: could be KV cache warm vs cold. synthetic requests might not reuse prefixes in the same way.
michael: i thought of that. I forced kvcache disabled and reran both. overhead gap shrank but still there (~10% synth vs 5% replay).
sarah: do we see different kernel selection on the synth runs? maybe different sequence lengths cause different attention kernels.
kevin: profiling snapshot from the synthetic run (cpu flame):
```text
SYNTH_RUN_1773456000
- aten::matmul_kernel 42%
- attention::dot_product_optimized 18%
- json_validation 9%
- io/serialization 7%
- other 24%
```

jordan: replay profile (same model):
```text
REPLAY_RUN_1773456500
- aten::matmul_kernel 35%
- attention::dot_product_generic 22%
- json_validation 3%
- io/serialization 5%
- other 35%
```

anya: note attention kernel difference: optimized vs generic. kernel selection might be influenced by observed seq length distribution in the batcher. synthetic hammer likely creates larger effective max-seq, switching kernel.
michael: how do we force apples-to-apples? can we cap max_seq or pad sequences similarly?
olivia: we have a harness flag to preserve original spacing/timestamps: `--preserve-interarrival`. also `--max-seq` and `--force-kernel=auto|optim|generic`.
kevin: tried `--force-kernel=generic` on synth, overhead dropped to match replay (json-validation still slightly higher).
anya: that suggests kernel selection explains most of the delta. what's left is JSON-mode behavior + validation and retries. any evidence of retries?
dev-bot: CI alert: 1773456701 - toolcall retry spike observed on synth harness (rate: 1.8% -> 3.2%).
sarah: retries likely because synth floods causes transient backpressure and validation timeouts? we have short-circuit retry logic for toolcall failures.
jordan: can you paste the toolcall log lines where validation fails?
kevin: snippet: 
```json
{"ts":"1773456701","req_id":"r-9ab","stage":"validation","err":"malformed-json","payload":"{...truncated...}"}
{"ts":"1773456702","req_id":"r-9ab","stage":"retry","reason":"validation_timeout"}
```

michael: those malformed-json entries look like partial truncations. maybe streaming chunk boundaries differ under heavy batching.
anya: we saw a bug where structured-mode serializer didn't flush on batch-coalescing edge-case. fixed in internal PR #4123 but not backported to the test image used by synth runs.
michael: oh. are replay harnesses using the patched runtime?
olivia: replay runs use the canary image that has #4123, synth harness uses the baseline nightly. that explains the malformed JSON and retry gap.
jordan: so root causes: (1) kernel selection differences due to different max-seq/packing; (2) unpatched serializer bug causing validation failures under synthetic coalescing; (3) possibly KV warm effects.
kevin: action items:
- mike: re-run synth with `--force-kernel=optim` and `--image=canary-4123` and `--preserve-interarrival` to converge on replay conditions.
- anya: add a debug flag to log batch packing stats and per-request seq_max used.
- olivia: ensure replay harness can run a purely synthetic back-to-back mode for cross-check.
- jordan: run a cold/warm kvcache experiment to quantify perf delta.
michael: i'll start the synth job now and post results.
sarah: also update the benchmark doc with explicit apples-to-apples checklist: kernel pinned, image pinned, kvcache state, interarrival distribution. otherwise numbers are meaningless.
kevin: +1 on doc. lose the "synthetic vs replay" hand-wavy comparisons.
michael: running -> job id: synth-1773456802. will paste perf summary when done. :eyes:
olivia: thanks — if synth still diverges after forcing kernel + canary image we'll dig into batching heuristics next (thresholds for coalescing and flush windows).
michael: posted quick summary: synth forced optim kernel + canary image + preserve interarrival -> JSON overhead = 5.8%, retries 0.4%, tail p99 latency within 3% of replay.
anya: great. that matches. looks like majority of discrepancy explained.
jordan: please keep the run artifacts and full profiles at https://internal.perf/redwood/1773456802 (link only for eng).
michael: attaching minimal repro snippet for anyone who wants to run locally: 
```bash
# reproduce locally (needs local model + canary image)
./harness --input prompts.json --mode synth --preserve-interarrival \
  --force-kernel=optim --image canary-4123 --max-batch-size 32
```

michael: thanks everyone. i'll open a short postmortem on the benchmarking repo summarizing causes and the apples-to-apples checklist. :white_check_mark:
